subject: Zero Two (02), DARLING in the FRANXX
purpose: Locally bundled static background for the workbench and read-only appearance preview
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a static wide 16:9 desktop wallpaper for a black-and-white developer workbench. Create a polished anime illustration of Zero Two (02) from DARLING in the FRANXX, recognizable long pastel-pink hair with straight bangs, small red horns, turquoise-green eyes, and her red military-style long-sleeved uniform coat with a white collar and dark necktie. Fully clothed, calm confident expression with a slight mischievous smile, natural three-quarter standing pose, waist-up framing, anatomically clean hands if visible. Beautiful fine 2D anime linework and delicate cel-painting, soft nuanced shading, clean elegant silhouette and detailed hair strands; no photorealism or plastic 3D look.
Composition is designed around an existing desktop dashboard: place the character in the right third with her face around 70 percent of canvas width and upper-middle height, sufficient safe margin above the horns; hair gently arcs toward the right. The left 55 percent should be a mostly quiet near-black charcoal expanse with a subtle soft gray atmospheric gradient, seamless with the background behind the character. Keep the bottom left quiet too. Portrait readable and attractive at desktop size, no excessive microtexture. Muted pink hair and restrained deep crimson coat provide the only substantial color accents; soft silver rim lighting separates her from the dark background. Balanced contrast, no glaring glow. Dark and understated overall, suitable behind crisp white interface typography. The background is abstract, simple and static, with no illustrated interface or scenery competing for attention.
Exactly one character. No text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no UI controls, no mecha, no weapons, no dragon, no planets, no stars, no extra characters, no revealing outfit, no suggestive pose.
